claims.statement: Referrals for neurodevelopmental assessments are projected to reach 1,319 cases in 2025-26.
claims.sourceQuote: Referrals for neurodevelopmental assessments have seen a dramatic increase, from 47 in 2018-19 to a projected 1,319 in 2025-26.
claims.sourceDocument: Health Overview and Scrutiny Panel Kingston upon Thames, 22 October 2026

claims.statement: In Kingston, 547 children were on the waiting list with waits lasting up to two and a half years.
claims.sourceQuote: In Kingston alone, 547 children were awaiting assessment, with some facing waits of up to two and a half years.
claims.sourceDocument: Health Overview and Scrutiny Panel Kingston upon Thames, 22 October 2026

claims.statement: The number of young people waiting for Tier 2 support dropped by approximately 40 per cent.
claims.sourceQuote: Since then, while referrals have increased, the number of children and young people waiting for treatment has reduced by around 40%, now standing at 145.
claims.sourceDocument: Health Overview and Scrutiny Panel Kingston upon Thames, 22 October 2026

takeawayCard.title: NHS Trust Takes Over Services
takeawayCard.subtitle: Providers clear backlogs under new NHS care models.

keyPoints: Annual referrals surged dramatically from 47 to a projected 1,319 cases.
In Kingston alone, 547 children faced assessment waits reaching thirty months.
Getting help waiting lists fell by forty per cent to 145.
